item.title: How the La-5 Changed the Air War on the Eastern Front
item.description: The Lavochkin La-5 marked a turning point for Soviet fighter aviation during the Second World War. It was the first domestically produced fighter to reach rough parity with German aircraft on the Eastern Front, restoring confidence at a time when earlier designs consistently fell short.
